test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following options is the most suitable conversion of the following sentence into Passive Voice?

People believed that he was innocent.

options.text: It will believe that he was innocent.
He was believe to be innocent by people.
It was believed that he was innocent.
His innocence was believe by people.

solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. It was believed that he was innocent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **active voice**: "People believed that he was innocent."
 
• To convert this sentence into the **passive voice**, the following changes are required:
 
 
• The object of the active sentence ("that he was innocent") becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• The verb "believed" is changed to its passive form "was believed."
 
• The subject of the active sentence ("People") is either omitted (as it's a general reference) or retained in a prepositional phrase starting with "by."
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct passive voice conversion is: **"It was believed that he was innocent."**

Correct sentence: *It was believed that he was innocent.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Key rules for converting active to passive voice:**

 
 
• The object of the active voice becomes the subject in the passive voice.
 
• The verb is replaced with its corresponding passive form: **be + past participle**.
 
• The subject of the active voice is either omitted (if it's a general reference) or introduced using "by."
 
 
 
• **Example:**
 
 
• Active: "The team completed the project."
 
• Passive: "The project was completed by the team."
